# UI/UX Implementation Skill

## Purpose
Build responsive, accessible, and high-quality user interfaces following design systems.

## Web experience preflight

If `experience-blueprint.yml` applies, read it before `design.md`.
If `design.md` is absent or contains "DRAFT - NOT LOCKED", stop page-level UI work.
Do not convert a declared experience into a locked or verified claim from file generation alone.

1. Confirm the blueprint profile and declared experience facts.
2. Preserve reference and asset provenance; learn from references without copying.
3. Resolve named semantic tokens, type roles and locale coverage, hierarchy,
   imagery rules, a closed motion budget, mobile composition, accessibility,
   and performance budgets with the owner.
4. Record owner approval and the design SHA-256 before changing the experience
   maturity or starting page implementation.
5. Implement modular UI components only from the locked design system.
6. Run visual, responsive, accessibility, and functional evidence. Keep
   Lighthouse lab evidence distinct from field performance evidence.
